why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Check that you're eligible (see below). You must be 18, and the terms bar US and Ontario residents.

Open app.decibel.trade from decibel.trade , and connect an EVM, Solana, Sui or Aptos wallet, or sign in with email, Google or Apple. Warning A Telegram group titled as official isn't linked from Decibel's site or docs. Stick to its X account and Discord, and never enter a seed phrase.

If a friend gave you a referral code, add it now. Once you start, it's too late: "an account that has already deposited or traded can no longer bind a code". It's optional, and it gives you no fee discount.
Click Deposit and pick the chain your USDC is on. Decibel bridges it for you.

Trade perps or spot, or put USDC in the DLP vault. Amps accrue daily and show on the points dashboard. Warning Leverage can wipe out your margin. Decibel's scoring favours moderate leverage and longer holds, so there is no reason to max it out for points.
Open the rewards page now and then. Campaign rewards need a claim and they expire, and Decibel doesn't have to remind you.
costs: There is no entry fee, but no free route to Amps either. All four pools need trading, a deposit or referrals. Starting fees are 0.045% taker and 0.015% maker on perps, and 0.070% and 0.040% on spot. By our arithmetic, $25,000 of perps volume as a taker costs about $11.25 at that rate.
